SELECT r.bill_month AS billMonth, COALESCE(SUM(r.amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM wms_client_billing_record r
GROUP BY r.bill_month

SELECT r.logistics_product_id AS productId, COUNT(*) AS usageCount, COALESCE(SUM(r.amount), 0) AS amount FROM wms_client_billing_record r
GROUP BY r.logistics_product_id ORDER BY amount DESC

SELECT r.erp_tenant_id AS erpTenantId, t.tenant_name AS ownerName, COALESCE(SUM(r.amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS usageCount FROM wms_client_billing_record r LEFT JOIN sys_tenant t ON t.id = r.erp_tenant_id
GROUP BY r.erp_tenant_id, t.tenant_name ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS enabled FROM sys_tenant WHERE tenant_type = 'ERP_USER' AND parent_wms_tenant_id = #{wmsTenantId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS enabled FROM wms_logistics_product WHERE wms_tenant_id = #{wmsTenantId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.available_quantity + i.reserved_quantity + i.damaged_quantity), 0) FROM wms_inventory i INNER JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = i.warehouse_id AND w.warehouse_type = 'OWN' AND w.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sys_tenant t ON t.id = i.erp_tenant_id AND t.parent_wms_tenant_id = #{wmsTenantId}
AND i.erp_tenant_id IN #{e}
